```{r}
# Install the necessary packages (if not installed)
packages <- c("sf", "spdep", "spatialreg", "readr", "dplyr", "tmap", "ggplot2", "officer", "flextable")
installed <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(!installed)) install.packages(packages[!installed])

# Load packages
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(officer)
library(flextable)

# 1. Read data
shp_path <- "/Users/liyang/Desktop/Codes/6. Discussion/MSOA shapefile/MSOA_2011_London_gen_MHW.shp"
csv_path <- "/Users/liyang/Desktop/毕设/C-M/df_long1.csv"

msoa_shp <- st_read(shp_path)
panel_data <- read_csv(csv_path) %>%
  mutate(ln_income = log(income))  

# Merge spatial data
msoa_data <- left_join(msoa_shp, panel_data, by = c("MSOA11CD" = "MSOA11CD"))

# Construct the adjacency matrix (full sample)
nb <- poly2nb(msoa_data)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

# Extract the subset of years
msoa_2011 <- msoa_data %>% filter(year == 2011)
msoa_2021 <- msoa_data %>% filter(year == 2021)

# Calculate Moran’s I
moran_income_2011 <- moran.test(msoa_2011$ln_income, nb2listw(poly2nb(msoa_2011)))
moran_income_2021 <- moran.test(msoa_2021$ln_income, nb2listw(poly2nb(msoa_2021)))
moran_imd_2011 <- moran.test(msoa_2011$imd, nb2listw(poly2nb(msoa_2011)))

# Re-construct the adjacency matrix and weight matrix for the subset of 2021 to avoid length mismatch
nb_2021 <- poly2nb(msoa_2021)
lw_2021 <- nb2listw(nb_2021, style = "W")
moran_imd_2021 <- moran.test(msoa_2021$imd, lw_2021)
```

```{r}
# Add OA layer
oa_path <- "/Users/liyang/Desktop/Codes/6. Discussion/OA.gpkg/Opportunity_Areas.gpkg"
oa_layer <- st_read(oa_path)
oa_layer <- st_transform(oa_layer, crs = st_crs(msoa_2021))
```

```{r}
# Generate LISA Map - ln income (2021)
income_lisa <- localmoran(msoa_2021$ln_income, listw = lw_2021)
msoa_2021$income_lisa_I <- income_lisa[, 1]
msoa_2021$income_lisa_p <- income_lisa[, 5]

lisa_map_income <- tm_shape(msoa_2021) +
  tm_polygons("income_lisa_I", palette = "-RdBu", style = "quantile", title = "Local Moran's I (ln_income)") +
  tm_shape(oa_layer) +
  tm_borders(col = "yellow", lwd = 2) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("right", "top"), size = 2) +
  tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_add_legend(type = "line",
              labels = "Opportunity Areas",
              col = "yellow",
              lwd = 3) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Figure 11. LISA Cluster Map of ln_income (2021)",
            legend.outside = TRUE)

lisa_map_income
tmap_save(lisa_map_income, filename = "Figure11_LISA_ln_income_2021.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# Generate LISA Map - IMD (2021)
imd_lisa <- localmoran(msoa_2021$imd, listw = lw_2021)
msoa_2021$imd_lisa_I <- imd_lisa[, 1]
msoa_2021$imd_lisa_p <- imd_lisa[, 5]

lisa_map_imd <- tm_shape(msoa_2021) +
  tm_polygons("imd_lisa_I", palette = "-Blues", style = "quantile", title = "Local Moran's I (IMD)") +
  tm_shape(oa_layer) +
  tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", position = c("right", "top"), size = 2) +
  tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_add_legend(type = "line",
              labels = "Opportunity Areas",
              col = "red",
              lwd = 3) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Figure 12. LISA Cluster Map of IMD Income Score (2021)",
            legend.outside = TRUE)

lisa_map_imd
tmap_save(lisa_map_imd, filename = "Figure12_LISA_IMD_2021.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r}
# Run SDM model for ln_income
sdm_data <- msoa_data %>%
  dplyr::select(MSOA11CD, year, ln_income, imd, oa, pop, unem, edu, mig)

sdm_data$year <- as.factor(sdm_data$year)

sdm_income <- lagsarlm(ln_income ~ oa + pop + unem + edu + mig,
                       data = sdm_data,
                       listw = lw,
                       type = "mixed")
sdm_income
```

```{r}
# Run SDM model for imd
sdm_imd <- lagsarlm(imd ~ oa + pop + unem + edu + mig,
                    data = sdm_data,
                    listw = lw,
                    type = "mixed")
sdm_imd
```

```{r}
# Export the SDM regression results to Word
extract_coef <- function(model) {
  coefs <- summary(model)$Coef
  data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(coefs),
    Coefficient = round(coefs[, 1], 5),
    Std_Error = round(coefs[, 2], 5),
    p_value = round(coefs[, 4], 5)
  )
}

income_df <- extract_coef(sdm_income)
imd_df <- extract_coef(sdm_imd)

ft_income <- flextable(income_df)
ft_imd <- flextable(imd_df)

doc2 <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Table 11. SDM Results for ln_income", style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_income) %>%
  body_add_par("Table 11. SDM Results for IMD", style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_imd)

print(doc2, target = "SDM.docx")
```
